title: Civilian healthcare reaps substantial spin-offs ______ aerospace engineering.
subtitle: from

questions.en: Civilian healthcare reaps substantial spin-offs from aerospace engineering.

questions.hint: reap benefits/rewards from + nguồn: thu được lợi ích hoặc thành quả từ nguồn đó.
